sentences.en: The double helix that encodes our genome is an elegant structure.
sentences.zh: 编码我们基因组的双螺旋结构非常优雅。

sentences.en: DNA is known for its double helix shape.
sentences.zh: DNA以其双螺旋形状而闻名。

sentences.en: Your admittedly impressive knowledge of helix geometry is of tertiary importance to our present goals.
sentences.zh: 你对螺旋几何学的了解虽然令人印象深刻，但对我们当前目标的重要性只是第三位。
